title: Chapter 91: Strangeness On The Battlefield
content:
Chapter 91: Strangeness On The Battlefield

As expected by Meng, when the strange atmosphere on the battlefield continued to rise, suddenly a terrifying and indescribable scream came from the battlefield, and Wu Qing felt creepy when he heard it!

The Tengu clan also felt something was wrong, and immediately increased their investment in luck. The powerful luck forcibly suppressed the various auras rising on the battlefield.

"Alas, if this happens, many more people will die on the battlefield tonight!"

"What kind of brains do these Tengu clan people have!"

Meng no longer gloated at this time. Seeing the Tengu clan's such a coquettish operation, he was really angry.

Yu Chong and Bai Yan have been watching from the side, silently.

Meng saw Wu Qing looking over, so he explained: "Just now, I don't know how many strange weird things invaded the battlefield in ways we don't know."

"They have merged with the things on the battlefield. Now, no matter how strong the protection ability of the luck formation is, it can't distinguish those things as weird!"

Wu Qing learned a lot of knowledge about this world from Meng, which broadened his horizons.

"It turns out that the protection of luck is not omnipotent!"

Wu Qing thought that with the protection of the world rule level, everything would be fine when facing weird things in the future. Unexpectedly, such world rules also have loopholes to find.

"Of course, in some places, weird things can even appear during the day, and can sneak into the city of the territory through various means and live like normal people!"

"In some powerful territories, there will be people in the city who are specifically responsible for weird events to clean up these infiltrating weird things."

Hearing Meng say this, it seemed that another door to this world was opened for Wu Qing.

On the battlefield, Meng's words came true immediately. People who were cleaning up the battlefield were killed on the spot by the weapons that suddenly attacked.

Some of these attacks were launched by corpses that suddenly revived, while others were strange and unpredictable because the source of the attacks could not be distinguished.

Then some people were instantly pulled into the pile of corpses and disappeared.

There were also those huge corpses that suddenly jumped up and bit people.

Various strange events occurred frequently, making the soldiers and logistics personnel who were performing cleaning tasks on the battlefield terrified.

Although the battlefield was a certain distance away, the light on the battlefield was sufficient, and Wu Qing could still see a lot of things with his eyesight.

Wu Qing found that all the strange attacks on the battlefield were physical attacks, and there was no more effective spiritual attack.

He guessed that it might be the luck that was at work, making it impossible for the strange to launch spiritual attacks.

But even physical attacks are very hidden, and they cannot be detected before they launch an attack.

Due to the interference of the weirdness, the speed of clearing the battlefield has been greatly reduced. Many soldiers have begun to patrol and guard the battlefield to ensure the safety and order of the battlefield.

Because the weirdness is integrated into the battlefield, there is no way to find it. No matter how many soldiers are on guard and patrol, it is futile and there is no way to change the status quo.

...

Faced with this situation, even the elder Gou Hong of the Tengu clan, who has always been as still as a mountain, has rarely lost his temper.

"What time is it?! Still fighting for that little luck!"

"What a good thing you did! Let's see how you end it!"

Gou Hong threw down two words and left. He was blind to the net.

Leaving behind a group of high-level people from the Endless Mountain Branch of the Tengu clan, looking at each other.

"The battle with the evil god camp has been won! It doesn't matter if we lose some troops and personnel now!"

"Let's do it this way!"

Soon after the elder Gou Hong left, someone left this message and followed him.

Others followed suit and left one after another.

In the end, only Gou Yin was left sitting in the hall.

…

"Meng, do you think it's risky for me to send a Zerg to help?"

Wu Qing suddenly asked Meng.

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan were all surprised.

"You want to let the Zerg go through such a mess?"

Meng asked puzzledly.

"As long as the Zerg can reach the battlefield safely, the Zerg will find and eliminate the weird things on the battlefield."

"Now it depends on whether the Zerg army will face big risks on the way to the battlefield after leaving the lord's shelter area."

Wu Qing was not sure about the short distance that the Zerg army would march in the wild. He had never done such a thing before and didn't know if it would attract terrifying weird things.

"Do you really want to help?"

"There are risks in this short journey of the Zerg army to the battlefield, but they are not very big."

"The strange eyes around are attracted by the battlefield. As long as we pass quickly, it should not be a big problem with the strength of the Zerg!"

"If you really want to go, let the Zerg take this fortune array map with you!"

Meng said, and took out a square fortune array map in a silk bag from his body and handed it to Wu Qing.

"When you meet a big guy, just use your mental power to open the array map. I have injected enough luck into the array map!"

Wu Qing was not polite. He took the fortune array map, opened the silk bag and took a look. There was a jade square plate with a bright and restrained light inside. He used his mental power to explore it and understood how to use it.

Pulling the silk bag, Wu Qing handed the fortune array map to the one-star host flying over. The one-star host stretched out a tentacle and flexibly rolled up the fortune array map.

Meng keenly noticed that the host in the sky that made it easier for him to ignore seemed to be more powerful.

"I won't say thank you. I'll let the Zerg go over and try. If they can successfully enter the battlefield, maybe there will be some gains tonight!"

Wu Qing led ten one-star hosts, carried the fortune array map, and led the assembled 10,000 Zerg troops to rush towards the battlefield.

In the military camps outside the city within the lord's protection area, the troops of the Tengu tribe stationed there were all frightened, fearing that these Zerg tribes were going to cause trouble for them. Fortunately, they were just a false alarm.

Wu Qing directly possessed a one-star host with his consciousness.

The Zerg army rushed out of the lord's protection area and rushed into the wild without any hesitation.

Wu Qing felt that after leaving the lord's protection area, the inexplicable strange feeling came again.

The Zerg army was not affected by the environment and rushed to the battlefield quickly, which made the Tengu tribe who noticed the Zerg's movements puzzled. They were all very curious, what was the Zerg going to do?

Not long after the Zerg army ran, Wu Qing sensed through the hosts' terrifying detection ability that there seemed to be countless eyes staring at the Zerg army in the darkness, and those unknown existences were all ready to move.

These things were not very powerful, Wu Qing asked the Queen of Zerg to release a powerful mental pressure through the one-star host, and instantly made all kinds of strange things in the darkness dare not act rashly.

The distance between the city occupied by the Zerg and the battlefield was not far, and with the deterrence of the Queen of Zerg's mental pressure, it actually allowed the Zerg army of 10,000 to rush into the battlefield easily.
